tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Book a personalised demo of Sei AI's compliant AI agents for your financial institution. Provide your name, company, email, and the topics you'd like to cover.

tools.name: get_capability_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Sei platform capability by its ID.

id.description: Capability ID: voice-agents, document-intelligence, or call-monitoring

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Get all Sei AI customer success stories with results and links. Includes mortgage lenders, banks, and fintechs.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get key information about Sei AI: who they are, what they build, founding team, and how to contact them.

tools.name: get_platform_capabilities
tools.description: Get the three core capabilities of the Sei AI platform: voice agents, document intelligence, and call monitoring & compliance. Use this to answer questions about what Sei does.

tools.name: get_security_info
tools.description: Get Sei AI security certifications, compliance posture, and the financial regulations the platform is trained on.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the clean Markdown version of any page on Sei's website. Pass a site path like '/blog/some-post', '/platform/voice-agents', or '/security'. Returns the page content as Markdown — the same content a human sees, without the page chrome.

path.description: Site path starting with '/', e.g. '/security' or '/blog/ai-agents-mortgage-brokers-lenders'. Use '/' for the homepage.
